name: web-charcoal-neobank-site-with-lime-analytics-phones-and-tiled-panels
title: Charcoal neobank site with a huge white 'Your Money, Simplified.', a lime-and-black analytics phone pair and dark tiled feature panels
whatItIs: A charcoal browser frame with a nav and a Download App link, a big tile with a headline, subline, lime Get Started and grey Showreel buttons and faded logos, beside a tile with two tilted silver phones showing a lime analytics chart and a white transactions list, and below two dark tiles: 'Your Finances, Safe Haven.' with security cards and 'Track Your Money Easily.' with tabs and a lime donut segment.
whatItMeans: Bold and high-contrast; lime on charcoal makes a neobank feel sharp and modern.
techniques: Split the page into dark rounded tiles.
Use lime as the only accent in phone UIs.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded charcoal panel in a grid.
A neon green used for actions and charts.
A secondary button with a play icon.
Partner logos at very low contrast.
